entries.note: Pseudoephedrine is a decongestant that can raise blood pressure in some people.
entries.pharmacistLine: Talk to your pharmacist before using this if you have high blood pressure.

entries.note: Phenylephrine is a decongestant that may raise blood pressure in some people.
entries.pharmacistLine: Talk to your pharmacist before using this if you have high blood pressure.

entries.note: Ibuprofen is an NSAID that can raise blood pressure and affect kidney function with regular use.
entries.pharmacistLine: Talk to your pharmacist about pain options that fit your blood pressure plan.

entries.note: Naproxen is an NSAID that can raise blood pressure and affect kidney function with regular use.
entries.pharmacistLine: Talk to your pharmacist about pain options that fit your blood pressure plan.

entries.note: Some effervescent tablets and antacids are high in sodium, which can raise blood pressure when used often.
entries.pharmacistLine: Ask your pharmacist to check the sodium content before regular use.
